item.title: Meal - Arayes
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g beef or lamb mince
  • 1 onion, grated and drained
  • 1 jalapeño, grated
  • 4 garlic cloves, grated
  • ¼ cup parsley, chopped
  • 1 tsp baharat
  • ½ tsp each cumin, paprika, salt and black pepper
  • 4 pita breads, halved
  • Olive oil

Directions

  1. Mix the mince with onion, jalapeño, garlic, parsley and spices.
  2. Spread a thin, even layer of filling inside each pita half.
  3. Brush the outside lightly with olive oil.
  4. Grill or pan-fry over medium heat for 4–5 minutes per side, then cook the open meat edge until the filling is cooked through.
  5. Serve hot with yoghurt or tahini sauce.

References

item.title: Meal - Bolognese Tacos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g beef mince
  • 1 large onion, chopped
  • 1 medium carrot, grated
  • 4 garlic cloves, chopped
  • 1 tsp each oregano, thyme, basil and garlic powder
  • 2 tsp each sweet paprika and dried parsley
  • Salt and black pepper
  • 1 tbsp tomato purée
  • 1½ cups tomato passata
  • ⅓ cup water
  • ½ vegetable stock cube
  • Grated cheddar
  • 5–6 mini tortilla wraps
  • ½ tbsp olive oil

Directions

  1. Soften the onion in olive oil, add the beef and brown over high heat for 5–6 minutes.
  2. Add garlic, carrot, passata, tomato purée, seasonings, stock and water.
  3. Cover and simmer for 15–20 minutes.
  4. Dip each tortilla in the sauce, place it in a hot pan, and layer with cheese and 2–3 tbsp of filling.
  5. Fold and grill both sides until browned and crisp.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Cheesy Bacon Jalapeño Popper Wrap
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Large tortilla wraps
  • Cream cheese, softened
  • Grated cheddar
  • Grated mozzarella
  • Cooked bacon, crumbled
  • Jalapeños, grilled and sliced

Directions

  1. Mix cream cheese, cheddar, mozzarella, bacon and jalapeños.
  2. Spread the filling over the centre of each tortilla.
  3. Fold the sides inward and roll tightly.
  4. Toast seam-side down in a dry pan, then turn until golden and the cheese has melted.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Chicken Parm Baked Wraps
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast, diced
  • Italian seasoning
  • Garlic powder
  • Tomato passata or marinara sauce
  • Grated mozzarella
  • Grated parmesan
  • Large tortilla wraps
  • Olive oil spray

Directions

  1. Season and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through.
  2. Stir through enough marinara to coat the chicken.
  3. Divide the chicken between tortillas and top with mozzarella and parmesan.
  4. Fold into wraps and place seam-side down on a lined tray.
  5. Spray lightly with oil and bake until crisp and the cheese has melted.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Feta Fried Egg Tortilla
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Egg - 1
  • Feta cheese - 2 tbsp (crumbled)
  • Tortilla - 1 small
  • Avocado - 1/4 (sliced)
  • Chilli oil - drizzle (optional)

Directions

  1. Sprinkle feta in a circle in a hot pan
  2. Once it starts melting, crack the egg into the centre
  3. Place tortilla on top and press down gently
  4. Cook until the egg sets and feta crisps
  5. Flip so tortilla side is down and toast briefly
  6. Remove, top with avocado and chilli oil
  7. Fold and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 380
  • Protein - 18g
  • Carbs - 28g
  • Fat - 22g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed recipe content :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • Very fast, high-flavour breakfast or snack
  • Texture comes from crispy feta + soft egg contrast

item.title: Meal - Garlic Honey BBQ Pulled Chicken Tacos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 700g boneless chicken breast
  • 1 cup BBQ sauce
  • ¼ cup honey
  • 4 garlic cloves, minced
  • 1 tsp each onion powder and smoked paprika
  • Salt and black pepper
  • 8 small tortillas
  • Coleslaw mix
  • Chopped coriander
  • Lime wedges

Directions

  1. Coat the chicken with BBQ sauce, honey, garlic, onion powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
  2. Cook covered on low until tender, then shred and mix it back through the sauce.
  3. Warm the tortillas and fill with pulled chicken and coleslaw.
  4. Finish with coriander and lime.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Loaded Breakfast Wrap
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Large wraps - 2
  • Eggs - 4
  • Bacon - 4 rashers
  • Cheese - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Hash browns - 2
  • Spinach or greens (optional)
  • Sauce (optional)
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Cook bacon until crispy, then set aside
  2. Cook hash browns until golden
  3. Scramble eggs in the same pan
  4. Layer eggs, bacon, hash browns, cheese, and greens into wraps
  5. Fold tightly into burrito shape
  6. Toast in pan until golden and crispy on the outside
  7. Slice and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 520
  • Protein - 32g
  • Carbs - 38g
  • Fat - 26g

Notes

  • Identified based on user verification
  • Typical “loaded breakfast wrap” structure (eggs + bacon + potato + cheese)
  • Good for quick breakfasts or meal prep

item.title: Meal - Nacho Beef Folded Wrap
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g beef mince
  • 1 packet taco seasoning
  • ¼ cup water
  • 4 large tortilla wraps
  • 1½ cups grated cheddar
  • 1 cup crushed nacho chips
  • 1 cup shredded lettuce
  • ½ cup diced tomatoes
  • ½ cup sour cream
  • 1 tbsp olive oil or butter

Directions

  1. Brown the beef, drain excess fat, then add taco seasoning and water and simmer until thick.
  2. Warm the tortillas and cut one slit from the centre to the edge.
  3. Divide cheese, beef, crushed chips, lettuce, tomato and sour cream between the four tortilla quarters.
  4. Fold each quarter over the next to make a layered triangle.
  5. Toast in oil or butter for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp.

References

  • Original Instagram post — no longer available; recipe matched by title and listed ingredients.

item.title: Meal - Smash Dumpling Tacos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g pork mince
  • 3 spring onions, sliced
  • Handful of coriander, chopped
  • 3 garlic cloves, crushed
  • 2 tsp ginger paste
  • 2 tbsp light soy sauce
  • 1 tbsp sesame oil
  • 2 tsp fish sauce
  • 1 tbsp black or rice vinegar
  • Black pepper
  • 12 mini tortillas
  • Olive oil
  • 1 cucumber, diced
  • 1 tbsp rice vinegar
  • ½ tsp salt
  • Dumpling dipping sauce, chilli oil and sesame seeds

Directions

  1. Combine pork, most of the spring onion and coriander, garlic, ginger, soy, sesame oil, fish sauce, vinegar and pepper.
  2. Toss cucumber with rice vinegar and salt.
  3. Spread a thin layer of pork filling over one side of each tortilla.
  4. Fry meat-side down in an oiled pan for about 4 minutes, then flip and crisp the tortilla for 1 minute.
  5. Top with cucumber, reserved herbs, sesame seeds and dipping sauce or chilli oil.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe
